words.example: Use a clip to clamp the papers together.
examples: The carpenter will clamp the two boards while the glue dries.
She had to clamp the lid so the wind would not blow it off.

words.example: I showed gratitude by writing a thank-you note.
examples: The team felt deep gratitude toward the coach who believed in them.
She filled the card with gratitude for all the help she had received.

words.example: Running in the hallway is forbidden at school.
examples: Feeding the animals is strictly forbidden in this park.
It is forbidden to use phones during the exam.

words.definition: made to be thrown away after using it
words.example: A disposable cup should be used only once.
examples: The picnic used disposable plates that no one had to wash.
Switching from disposable bottles to a reusable one saves money and trash.

words.definition: willing to try new or exciting things
words.example: The adventurous student wanted to try a new sport.
examples: An adventurous eater is happy to taste food from any country.
Being adventurous, she signed up for the rock-climbing club.

words.definition: able to use what you have to do or make something
words.example: The resourceful team fixed the poster with tape and string.
examples: A resourceful camper can start a fire with only a few dry twigs.
Being resourceful, he turned old jars into pots for the garden.

words.example: Helping the new student find her classroom was a commendable act of kindness.
examples: The firefighters showed commendable courage during the rescue.
Her commendable effort earned the respect of the whole class.

words.definition: careful about spending money or using resources
words.example: She is very thrifty and saves her money instead of spending it quickly.
examples: A thrifty shopper compares prices before buying anything.
Being thrifty, the family reused leftovers instead of wasting them.

words.example: These mushrooms are edible, so it is safe to cook and eat them.
examples: The chef decorated the cake with edible flowers.
Always make sure a wild berry is edible before tasting it.

words.definition: a way of thinking, feeling, or acting
words.example: His cheerful attitude made everyone in class smile.
examples: A positive attitude can help you keep trying after a mistake.
Her calm attitude kept the team relaxed during the game.

words.definition: having enough water in the body
words.example: Drink plenty of water to stay hydrated during gym class.
examples: Runners carry bottles so they stay hydrated on hot days.
Eating juicy fruit can help keep you hydrated.

words.example: It was reckless to ride your bike down the stairs.
examples: The reckless driver sped through the red light.
Skating without a helmet is a reckless thing to do.

words.definition: one of a kind; different from others
words.example: There was a unique coffee car driving in the street.
examples: Every snowflake has a unique shape that no other one shares.
Her unique painting style made her work easy to recognize.
